# benchmaxxing.lol - SOTA Charts for Non-SOTA Models

> A real open-source charting library wearing a fake frontier-model launch as its launch campaign.

## Overview
benchmaxxing is a tiny, zero-runtime-dependency TypeScript library that renders polished multi-panel benchmark graphics as deterministic SVG. It launched with **Meridian Dawn Preview**, a satirical fake-model announcement featuring BulshitBench, ChartArena, CherryPick-Hard, VibeBench, InferencePlot, CopiumEval II, SOTA Leakage, and BenchMaxxing.lol.

Every chart on the site — including the benchmarks proving the library is good at charts — was rendered by the library.

## Facts
- `npm i @benchmaxxing/charts`
- `import { benchmaxx, meridianDawnPreset } from "@benchmaxxing/charts"`
- `visualBias: "honest" | "startup" | "series-b"` changes emphasis only, never bar-height geometry.
- All scores on this site are synthetic satire, not claims about real models. Competitor names are parodies.
- MIT licensed. Created by Unfoundbox Crew.
